name: Mitsui High-tec, Inc.
summary: Mitsui High-tec, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of tooling and machine tools, electronic parts, and electrical parts in Japan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers press tooling, tooling for lead frames, and other tooling products; and Mitsui Automatic Core Assembly System, a tooling device. It also provides HPR-PCNCF-R, a small multi-function NC grinder; MSG-S500-R, a 5-axis NC grinder with 2 additional rotation axes; MSG-135HG, a large surface grinder; MSG-818PCNC, an NC grinder using original NC control; and MSG-200M, a manual type grinder.
